verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents running multiple autonomous agents in parallel across independent projects. This lets one user drive work across many items at once, but it is task-level parallelism, not a documented bulk-operation feature. Headless CLI scripting supports batch automation but is a building block, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-action capability (select many items and apply one operation), documented limits or behavior for batch runs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
